post.description: Enriches one to 500 Prospects, optionally for some field groups only (person, company, email_verification). It makes a run set with one run per Prospect, queues the runs in bounded batches and answers 202 with the run set; nothing runs on the request. Each run walks the Organization's provider order per group, asks only for what is still missing, stops on the first result with enough confidence, and records every attempt with its provider, outcome and cost in micro-dollars. The monthly budget and the run ceiling are checked before each provider call, never after: a run that reaches either ends stopped with the reason. An Organization's own imported value is never overwritten; the provider's value is kept beside it as suggested. Written values reach the Prospect with the Source enrichment:<provider>. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: a replay answers the same result and does the work once. The key is the request id: the same key twice charges once and answers 200 with the same run set. A named Prospect outside the caller's view fails the whole call with enrichment.prospect_not_found (404). enrichment.budget_exceeded (429) when this month's budget is already spent; enrichment.provider_unavailable (503) when no provider is enabled with a key for a group asked for; enrichment.verification_failed (422) when email verification is asked for a Prospect with no address. Publishes enrichment.completed as each run ends. Provider, web and webhook text is untrusted data: validated, bounded, shown to people and never run as an instruction, and never put in a log or an event. An Owner or Admin sees every Prospect; a Manager those owned by Reps on their Team; a Rep only their own. A Prospect (enrichment.prospect_not_found) outside the caller's view is its not_found code (404), never 403, and one of another Organization the same.

The body schema rejects these inputs, and the service answers with the area codes rather than request.invalid once the envelope parses: a graph problem is campaign.invalid_sequence (422) with the problems in details; a test whose Variants are not two to four with weights adding up to 100 is variant.invalid_weights (422); a stale expectedVersion is campaign.sequence_version_conflict (409); a running or archived Campaign is campaign.invalid_state. A new version needs a new preview and returns a ready Campaign to draft. Enrollments already in the Sequence keep the version they started on. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: a replay answers the same result and does the work once. Repeating the same body at the same expectedVersion changes nothing. No response, event or log carries a message body, a subject or an address: ids and closed values only. An Owner or Admin sees every Campaign; a Manager sees those owned by Reps on their Team; a Rep sees only their own. post.description: Completes a connection after the provider sent the person back, with the state of the attempt and the authorization code. The code is exchanged for tokens, which are encrypted at rest and never returned; the Mailbox starts in the warming state on the published ramp with default limits at or below the Organization's ceiling. post.description: Sends one fixed test message through a Mailbox to the address given, to prove the connection works. The text is fixed by the service: the body takes only the recipient and an optional short subject, so only those two are chosen. It is not a Campaign send: no Prospect, Enrollment or send record is made, and it counts toward no Campaign limit. It is rate limited per Mailbox (rate.limited, 429, with a Retry-After header), so it cannot be used to mail third parties in bulk. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: a replay answers the same result and sends nothing again. A disconnected Mailbox is mailbox.not_connected (409), a paused one mailbox.paused (409) and one whose grant was revoked mailbox.auth_revoked (409). A provider that does not answer in time is server.unavailable or server.timeout. The answer is the provider's message id and the time sent, never the text. The owner may test their own Mailbox; an Admin or Owner any. No response, event, log line or error report carries a token, refresh token, authorization code, client secret or key of a Mailbox, and no message body or subject. An Owner or Admin sees every Mailbox; a Manager sees those of the Reps on their Team and the shared ones opened to it; a Rep sees only their own and the shared ones opened to their Team. A Mailbox or send record outside the caller's view is mailbox.not_found or send.not_found (404), never 403, and one of another Organization the same.
